title: MDLC Synapse: See The Internet Clearly
excerpt: Network intelligence platform. Diagnose, analyze, and monitor every layer of your internet-facing stack from a single command center.
content_html:
Signal → Root Cause

See The InternetClearly

One command center to monitor your sites, APIs, DNS, and certificates.
Catch problems before your users do.

Example Dashboard

330+Edge Cities

99.99%Platform Uptime

//Diagnostic Capabilities

Every Layer → Every Signal ≋

Diagnostic pillars that isolate root causes across internet infrastructure

Multi-Region Monitoring

See It From Your Users’ Side

Your monitors run on Cloudflare’s global edge, 330+ cities across 120+ countries.
Before we alert you, every failure is re-checked from another region, so you catch real regional outages without the false alarms.

Multi-region verificationFewer false alarmsCatch regional outages

Layer-by-Layer Analysis

From Signal to Root Cause

Every check is broken down by layer: DNS, TCP, TLS, and application response, each one timed and validated on its own.
So when something is slow or broken, you see the exact layer that caused it, not just that the site is down.

Example analysis with sample data

DNSResolution

23ms

A record resolved via Cloudflare 1.1.1.1: 4 nameservers queried, DNSSEC valid

NetworkTCP Connect

18ms

TCP handshake to 104.26.10.78:443, 12 hops, 0% packet loss, MTU 1500

TLSHandshake

32ms

TLS 1.3 / AEAD-AES256-GCM, cert valid, chain complete, OCSP stapled

ApplicationTTFB

145ms

HTTP/2 200 OK, Server: cloudflare, CF-Cache-Status: HIT, 12.4 KB response

Latency Breakdown

Total 218ms, all layers healthy. TTFB is 66% of total latency, pointing at origin server response.

content_html_zh:
信号 → 根本原因

上网看清楚

一个指挥中心可监控您的站点、API、DNS 和证书。在用户之前发现问题。

仪表板示例

330+边缘城市

<200ms平均检查时间

99.99% 平台正常运行时间

//诊断能力

每一层 → 每个信号 ≋

隔离互联网基础设施根本原因的诊断支柱

多区域监控

从用户的角度来看

您的监控器在 Cloudflare 的全球边缘运行，覆盖 120 多个国家/地区的 330 多个城市。在我们提醒您之前，每个故障都会从另一个区域重新检查，因此您可以捕获真正的区域中断，而不会出现误报。

多区域验证减少误报捕获区域中断

逐层分析

从信号到根本原因

每项检查均按层进行细分：DNS、TCP、TLS 和应用程序响应，每一项都自行计时和验证。因此，当某些内容缓慢或损坏时，您可以看到导致其发生的确切层，而不仅仅是站点已关闭。

使用样本数据进行示例分析

23ms

18ms

TLS握手

32ms

TLS 1.3 / AEAD-AES256-GCM，证书有效，链完整，OCSP 装订

应用TTFB

145ms

HTTP/2 200 OK，服务器：cloudflare，CF 缓存状态：HIT，12.4 KB 响应

延迟分解

总计 218 毫秒，所有层均正常。 TTFB 占总延迟的 66%，指向源服务器响应。
